where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
expected_result: All money visible. Service Advisor has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Junior Service Advisor role has the 'See Financial Data' cross-toggle ON (confirmed on the staging system 'Service Advisor' role: seeFinancialData=true), so every dollar figure on a work order — the Financial Info card, the line Rate/Margin/Total columns, the Stats tab money, and the Finance tab invoice — must be visible.
expected_plain: Logged in as a Junior Service Advisor, every price and dollar amount on a work order should be visible, nothing hidden.
actual_result_plain: Opened invoiced work order S9-24661 as Tech-with-Service-Advisor. All money visible everywhere. The Financial Info card showed Parts $0.00, Labor $929.72, Shop Supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST $51.37, Total $1,078.71. The lines grid showed the Rate $232.43 column. The Stats tab showed the Sell/Cost/Margin money ($929.72 etc). The Finance tab rendered the full invoice with Labor $929.72, Shop supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST $51.37, Total $1,078.71. Nothing was masked or hidden.
notes: seeFinancialData=true verified on the assigned system Service Advisor role via /api/auth/me/fe-permissions.

where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
what_to_do: Try to delete the work order.
expected_result: BLOCKED. Service Advisor has Work Orders = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Junior Service Advisor has Work Orders = View + Create/Edit only, with NO Delete (confirmed on the staging system role: workOrdersView + workOrdersCreateAndEdit present, workOrdersDelete absent). So there must be no way to delete a work order from the UI.
expected_plain: As a Junior Service Advisor, opening a work order should offer no option to delete it.
actual_result_plain: Opened approved work order S9-24674 as Tech-with-Service-Advisor and opened the work order's top-right options menu. The menu contained only 'Audit Log' and 'Timesheets (0)'. There was NO Delete option anywhere in the menu. The work order cannot be deleted, exactly as expected.
notes: WO nav-bar menu (data-test-id button_work_order_nav_bar_menu) had 0 delete entries. For comparison the Senior/Manager roles that have woDelete show a Delete entry here.

where_to_go: Customers → a customer; Vendors → a vendor
what_to_do: Look for Unpaid Invoices / Payments / Credits tabs.
expected_result: HIDDEN. Service Advisor has Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable OFF.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Junior Service Advisor has the 'Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable' (seeApArData) cross-toggle OFF (confirmed on the staging system role: seeApArData=false). The checklist therefore expects the customer/vendor AP-AR tabs (Unpaid Invoices / Payments / Credits) to be HIDDEN.
expected_plain: As a Junior Service Advisor, opening a customer (or vendor) should NOT show the accounts-receivable/payable tabs like Invoices, Payments and Deposits/Credits.
actual_result_plain: Opened customer 'new test' (eb304603) as Tech-with-Service-Advisor. The customer detail DID show the AR tabs: Work Orders (3), Part Sales, Contacts (1), Assets (1), Notes, Invoices (1), Payments (1), Deposits (1) — with live counts, so they load real AR data. This matches exactly what Admin (AP/AR ON) sees on the same customer, i.e. the tabs are NOT hidden for the SA. Root cause found in the frontend bundle: these tab routes are gated by requiredAnyPermission:['seeApArData','invoicingPaymentsDelete'] (an OR), and the Service Advisor role has invoicingPaymentsDelete=true, so the tabs unlock via the invoicing-delete permission despite seeApArData being OFF. (Note: the pure AP/AR-only surfaces — AR/AP Aging reports and IBS batch payments, which require seeApArData ALONE — are still hidden, and SA has no Reports page access anyway. The vendor detail page could not be reached at /parts/vendors/{id} — it 404s for Admin too, so the vendor route differs; the customer side alone already contradicts the expectation.)
replication_steps_plain: 1. Log in as the Tech user assigned the Service Advisor role. 2. Click Customers in the top nav. 3. Open any customer (e.g. 'new test'). 4. Look at the row of tabs under the customer name. 5. Observe that Invoices, Payments and Deposits tabs are present and show counts — they are NOT hidden, even though the role's Manage AP/AR toggle is OFF. Expected them to be hidden.
notes: Deviation is a consequence of the v33 invoicing model: the AR tabs are unlocked by invoicingPaymentsDelete (which SA has), not only by seeApArData. So 'AP/AR OFF hides these tabs' does not hold for a role that also has invoicing delete. Flag for spec owner: expected result likely stale for this role.

expected_result: BLOCKED. Service Advisor has Vendor and Order Management = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete → cannot delete return.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Junior Service Advisor cannot delete a part return because the role lacks the required Delete permission (staging role has vendorOrderManagementView + vendorOrderManagementCreateAndEdit and partSalesView/CreateAndEdit, but NO vendorOrderManagementDelete and NO partSalesDelete). So the Delete Return action must not be available.
expected_plain: As a Junior Service Advisor, opening/selecting a part return should give no way to delete it.
actual_result_plain: Went to Parts → Returns as Tech-with-Service-Advisor and selected a return row. No 'Delete Return' action appeared anywhere (the row-action area was empty). For direct comparison, on the exact same screen an Admin selecting the same return DOES get a 'Delete Return' action. So deletion is correctly blocked for the SA.
notes: Confirmed permission-gated: Admin shows Delete Return, SA shows none. SA lacks vendorOrderManagementDelete and partSalesDelete.

expected_result: BLOCKED. Delete-return now requires Invoicing & Payments: Delete (v33). Service Advisor has Invoicing = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete. (Correct outcome, updated reason.)
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319 v33, deleting a return should be gated by a Delete permission the Junior Service Advisor does not have, so the outcome must be BLOCKED.
expected_plain: As a Junior Service Advisor, there should be no way to delete a part return.
actual_result_plain: Selected a return in Parts → Returns as Tech-with-Service-Advisor; no Delete Return action was available, whereas Admin on the same return sees Delete Return. Deletion is correctly blocked.
notes: OUTCOME matches expected (blocked). IMPORTANT: the v33 stated REASON is inaccurate for the deployed role — this staging 'Service Advisor' role actually HAS invoicingPaymentsDelete=true (verified via /api/auth/me/fe-permissions), yet the return still cannot be deleted. So the delete-return gate is NOT invoicingPaymentsDelete for this role; the block comes from the missing vendorOrderManagementDelete/partSalesDelete. Flag for spec owner: v33 note says SA lacks Invoicing Delete, but SA has it.
